WITH vendedores AS (
    SELECT 
        s.seller_id,
        SUM(oi.price) AS ingresos,
        AVG(rv.review_score) AS calificacion,
        SUM(CASE WHEN e.entrega_con_retraso = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(e.order_id) AS pct_retrasos
    FROM 
        sellers s
    JOIN 
        order_items oi ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
    JOIN 
        vw_pedidos_validos p ON oi.order_id = p.order_id
    LEFT JOIN 
        order_reviews rv ON p.order_id = rv.order_id
    LEFT JOIN 
        vw_entregas_retrasos e ON p.order_id = e.order_id
    GROUP BY 
        s.seller_id
    HAVING 
        COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) >= 30
),
vendedores_ordenados AS (
    SELECT 
        seller_id, 
        ingresos, 
        calificacion, 
        pct_retrasos,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ingresos DESC) AS rank_ingresos,
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_vendedores
    FROM 
        vendedores
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS num_vendedores,
    SUM(ingresos) AS ingresos_totales
FROM 
    vendedores_ordenados
WHERE 
    rank_ingresos <= total_vendedores * 0.25
    AND (calificacion < 3.5 OR pct_retrasos >= 15)

WITH avg_review_score AS (
    SELECT AVG(review_score) AS avg_score FROM order_reviews WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM vw_pedidos_validos)
),
category_reviews AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS categoria,
        AVG(review_score) AS avg_category_score
    FROM 
        order_reviews rv
    JOIN 
        order_items oi ON rv.order_id = oi.order_id
    LEFT JOIN 
        products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    LEFT JOIN 
        product_category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
    WHERE 
        oi.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM vw_pedidos_validos)
    GROUP BY 
        categoria
    HAVING 
        COUNT(*) >= 100
),
global_delays AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS global_delay_pct
    FROM 
        vw_entregas_retrasos
    WHERE 
        order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    cr.categoria,
    cr.avg_category_score,
    (cr.avg_category_score < (SELECT avg_score FROM avg_review_score)) AS mala_calificacion,
    (cr.avg_category_score < (SELECT avg_score FROM avg_review_score) AND cr.avg_category_score < gd.global_delay_pct) AS mala_calificacion_con_retraso
FROM 
    category_reviews cr
JOIN 
    global_delays gd
